name: kitegtm
description: Ask about your KiteGTM missions, buyer fits, conversations and qualified opportunities, and act on them from Codex and ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: KiteGTM finds the companies and decision-makers that match what you sell, works them over email and LinkedIn, and hands you qualified opportunities. This plugin lets you ask about that work and act on it: see which missions need attention, read and answer conversations, review buyer fits and opportunities, pause or resume a mission, and record what came of an opportunity. Replies are sent only with the exact text you approve. Billing and payments stay in KiteGTM.
capabilities: Read missions, buyer fits, conversations and opportunities
Reply to a conversation with the text you approve
Pause, resume or stop a mission or a person
defaultPrompt: Which of my KiteGTM missions need attention?
Show me this week's qualified opportunities
Who replied today, and which replies need me?
